sources.publisher: Securities and Exchange Board of India
sources.summary: SEBI found the land-linked plans to be unregistered collective investment schemes, directed winding up and refund, recorded PACL defences and preserved genuinely certified sale deeds.
limitations: Archive: policy-evidence/pacl-order-2014-retry.receipt.json, original PDF and page-marked text. Initial incomplete HTTP read is separately logged.

sources.title: Delhi High Court: Ganeshgarhia Construction v NHAI, W.P.(C) 9232/2025
sources.summary: Records the alleged unrecorded toll collection, contractor defence, ₹10 lakh penalty and one-year debarment. Sets aside only debarment for procedural defects, leaving contractual remedies for termination/penalty.
limitations: Official URL was opened through indexed full-text fetch and retained as policy-evidence/dhc-toll-2025.official-indexed.txt with receipt. Direct official-host PDF GET attempts timed out; those failures are preserved.
Downloaded PDF bytes are supplied under the separate mirror source, not misrepresented as a successful official-host download.
Paragraph 41 calls the contract 25 July 2025, while paragraphs 1–2 and reproduced work order identify 25 July 2024. The latter identifies the contract here; discrepancy is not a second contract.
The judgment expressly refrains from underlying factual conclusions at paragraph 34. No later appeal, penalty recovery or contractual award was established by the current search.

records.title: PACL: unregistered land-linked schemes, agent payments and investor recovery
records.summary: SEBI found PACL’s land-linked plans to be unregistered collective investment schemes in August 2014. The source records ₹43.6478 billion of collections during 26 February 2013–15 June 2014, a separate historical commission route, and associate land-holding arrangements. Court-directed recovery subsequently produced ₹3,720.67 crore of cumulative refunds against 35,74,401 eligible applications by 5 May 2026; property objections and auction work continued in September 2026.
records.status: Regulatory finding with ongoing court-directed recovery; no criminal-conviction claim
records.dateBasis: Event dates and last verified status are distinct; historical aggregates are expressly labelled in the amount period.
records.period: 2013–2014 collections and 2014 regulatory finding; recovery observations through September 2026
records.response: PACL argued that it sold/developed land and relied on judicially verified deeds. SEBI rejected the CIS defence but expressly preserved genuinely certified sale deeds. SAT upheld the order in 2015. The September 2026 Supreme Court order disposes of specific property objections, not the whole case; bank-deficient refund applications had a rectification window through 6 October 2026.
alternativeExplanations: Some certified land transactions were genuine and are expressly protected by the 2014 order.
Bank-account deficiencies and property-title objections can delay payments without themselves proving fresh diversion.
records.falsifier: Reconcile scheme bank ledgers, paid commission schedules, genuine registered deeds, auction sale receipts and application-level refund acknowledgements without exposing investors’ private account data; later reasoned orders may change property eligibility or recovery status.

amounts.stage: PACL-admitted collections recorded by SEBI; not adjudicated net loss
cumulative refunds effected; 35,74,401 eligible applications

geography.note: India institutional or investor-scheme context; not evidence of a payment in every state.

limitations: Historical mobilisation, current liability, auction value, bank balance and refunds are different quantities; no net-loss estimate or recovery percentage derived.
This is a bounded public-source case, not a complete ledger of PACL entities, investors or criminal proceedings.

records.title: PACL response: land-sale defence and genuine-deed protection
records.summary: PACL claimed a real-estate business, invoked Justice K. Swamidurai’s verification of 19,284 sale deeds and proposed a five-year repayment arrangement. SEBI rejected the broader CIS defence, citing the 500-customer sample with no completed sale deed, while paragraph 37 expressly protects sale deeds certified as genuine.
records.status: Dated finding or response; current limits stated
records.dateBasis: Event dates and last verified status are distinct; historical aggregates are expressly labelled in the amount period.
records.response: The order cannot be paraphrased as finding every land sale fictitious. Historical certified deeds are counter-evidence to that overbroad claim; they did not defeat the scheme-level CIS finding.
records.falsifier: Check the cited original against any subsequent order and trace receipts separately from assessed amounts or asset values.

records.title: PACL recovery status: paid refunds, auction values and unresolved eligibility
records.summary: The memorandum expressly dates ₹3,720.67 crore cumulative refunds to 5 May 2026.
